findings.detail: The reason for option B says a structured handoff protocol 'must include' the completed work. The guide (1.4-K3, 1.4-S3) lists customer details or identifiers, root cause analysis and recommended actions. It does not list completed work as a required element, so the reason claims a requirement that the guide does not state.

blind_answer.reason: Per 1.4-K3/S3, escalating to a human who can't see the transcript calls for a structured handoff. It should name the affected service, the root cause, the work already completed and a recommended action. Raw transcripts, bare stack traces or a vague status message don't give the engineer what they need.
